تبتدهين (form VIII)
# تَبْتَدِهِينَ (tabtadihīna) /tab.ta.di.hiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# تُبْتَدَهِينَ (tubtadahīna) /tub.ta.da.hiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
